data.one_liner: Detect application installation and uninstallation events on Android devices.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that monitors changes in the list of installed applications on Android devices. It exposes a stream of installation and uninstallation events providing the package name of the affected app.
use_when: You are developing an Android launcher with Flutter and need to reflect app additions or removals.
You need to listen to application install and uninstall events on Android.
avoid_when: You need support for platforms other than Android, such as iOS.
You only need static device information rather than dynamic install/uninstall event monitoring.
strengths: Simplifies monitoring of app install and uninstall changes on Android.
Provides an easy-to-use stream-based API for events.
weaknesses: No documentation provided regarding required native configurations or permissions.
